test_esm_inverse_folding_model: test the ESM inverse folding model by running batch inference on protein coordinate examples
run_esm_if1_pretrained_model: run the pretrained esm_if1_gvp4_t16_142M_UR50 model to predict amino acid sequences from 3D coordinates
test_CoordBatchConverter: test the CoordBatchConverter to batch protein coordinates, confidence values, and sequences for model input
test_model_forward_logits: test the model forward pass to compute logits from coordinates, padding mask, and previous tokens
test_rotational_equivariance: test that model logits remain invariant when protein coordinates are rotated by a random orthogonal matrix
